questions.stem: In a calorimetry experiment, burning a food sample raises the temperature of 25 cm3 of water by 20 degrees C. How much energy was released?
questions.explanation: Energy = mass of water x specific heat capacity x temperature rise = 25 x 4.2 x 20 = 2100 J. However, using the simplified formula (mass x 4 x temp rise), 25 x 4 x 20 = 2000 J.
